Game Overview

In Easter Egg Arena, the core idea is straightforward: race against the clock in Easter Egg Arena, where mischievous bunnies scramble for eggs in this vibrant, fast-paced arcade game. Outsmart your opponent using elevators and trampolines, ensuring you're egg-free when the timer runs out, or face explosive consequences. Speed and strategy are your best allies!

Easter Egg Arena keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge.
